[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 15 August 2026.

[2026-08-15_PLTR]  
Video Title: AI Infrastructure Boom: Palantir $PLTR Analysis  
Video ID: B6bt9UCNdQ0  
Palantir (PLTR) | Class: EQUITY  

    Current Market Structure:  
    • The AI galaxy is currently in a value‑trap zone with an average gravity index exceeding the 30‑point threshold and hovering around 60/100.  
    • Leading AI names show divergent momentum: MSFT sits at a gravity of 78, NVDA at 57, while PLTR registers a raw gravity of 40 and a 90‑day RO of 18% (vs. NVDA’s 27%).  
    • In the last 30 days, PLTR eclipsed NVDA in performance, yet over 90 days NVDA remains the top performer.  
    • The sector’s risk level has surged past the historic purple‑line threshold (risk level 4) that was largely ignored during the late‑June 2026 sell‑off, pushing prices toward new all‑time highs that previously hovered just above the $200 mark.

    Quantitative Valuation & Gravity:  
    • The time‑weighted average price (TWAP) baseline for PLTR is $53; the model’s fair value sits at $385, implying a 200% premium over the expanding TWAP.  
    • Machine‑learning forecasts project a 10‑week upside from $180 to $210 under a base‑case scenario, with a rare‑guess boom case near $210 (base case $125).  
    • The 20‑, 100‑, and 200‑week SMAs place PLTR above the 20‑week line (short‑term euphoria indicator) but still within the 100‑week rally zone, signalling a high‑opt‑in growth position on the efficient frontier.  
    • The average gravity across AI stocks is 58, and 97% of the galaxy has posted positive 90‑day returns, underscoring robust momentum.

    Target Floors & Trap Identifications:  
    • The model identifies a 50% air‑gap requirement for PLTR to reach its fair value, meaning a 100% price rise from the current level is needed.  
    • Standard‑deviation bands suggest a panic floor around $125 (base case) and a non‑panic floor near $180; breaching below these would trigger a severe downturn.  
    • Value traps are flagged where the price sits at the maximum despair (–3 σ) yet remains in an AI euphoria phase, often leading to heightened upside volatility.  
    • Euphoria overextensions are evident as the sector’s risk level has eclipsed the purple‑line threshold, and PLTR’s accumulation algorithm currently places it in a neutral zone with a risk score of 161, higher than the median but still within the high‑growth, high‑volatility quadrant.
